story_context:
The stone altar shatters into dust. Black marrow seeps between the broken flagstones. Six segmented limbs drag a massive torso into the green light. A Crypt Behemoth hauls itself out of the abyss.

Piles of fused bone form its hunched carapace. Rusted iron plating bolts directly into the creature's spine. Four hollow eye sockets burn with pale frost. Its primary grip crushes a pitted tombstone wrapped in heavy executioner chains.

The executioner lowers his greatsword and takes a step back. The Wraith Lord raises its scythe toward the vault entrance. The behemoth exhales a cloud of frozen grave dust that coats the floor in rime. The sound rattles the teeth in Varek's skull.

The beast ignores the undead lords. It locks all four burning eyes on Varek. Its chest plate splits open to reveal a ribcage lined with reaching human hands.

story_context:
Green fire spills across the cracked stone. The smoke curls into a towering silhouette. Ribs of pale bone snap together inside the mist. A Wraith Lord steps out from the dead flame.

Tattered cloth drapes over floating iron plate. A spiked crown sits above a face of absolute darkness. Rune-carved chains bind its glowing ribcage. Its gauntleted right hand grips a three-pronged bone scythe.

The executioner lowers its greatsword. The wraith does not bow. It raises its weapon. Every dead rune in the vault begins to hum.

Varek grips his last dagger. The wraith turns toward the shadow behind the altar. Something far worse answers the call.

story_context:
The rusted war-cleaver shatters the stone floor where Varek stood. Dust chokes the vault. Out of the smoke steps a new nightmare. A Dread Executioner moves past the stumbling giant.

Layered plate armor covers its towering frame. Spiked pauldrons tilt outward over tattered black chainmail. An iron executioner mask hides its face. Green soul-fire pulses inside a cage chained to its waist.

The executioner drives a two-handed greatsword through the giant's iron knee. Rusted armor splits. The pit lord roars and crashes to the stone.

The executioner does not pause. It pulls its crimson blade free and locks its iron visor onto Varek. The soul-cage at its belt snaps open.

story_context:
A giant steps through the broken archway. Heavy iron plates bind its bloated, scarred flesh. Two massive horns curve outward from a spiked helm. The monster drags a notched war-cleaver along the stone floor. Sparks spray into the shadows.

The inquisitor freezes. Green fire dies along the halberd blade. Even holy steel hesitates before a pit lord. Varek pushes himself off the cracked wall. Blood blinds his left eye, but his sword hand stays steady. The smaller fiend slinks back between the giant's iron boots.

Black frost spreads across the stone floor. The titan raises its rusted blade with one hand. A low rumble shakes dust from the vaulted ceiling. The air smells of cold iron and dried blood.

Varek clears his vision. The inquisitor steps up beside him. Old enemies make quick pacts when a bigger killer enters the room. The giant swings.

story_context:
The smoke parts behind the fiend. A silent inquisitor steps into the embers. Layered plate encases its slender frame. A brass bird mask hides its face.

The figure grips an ornate halberd. Jagged blades flare from the spearhead. Tattered parchment banners hang from the haft, bound with heavy wax seals. Smoke rises from the iron boots.

The inquisitor raises a pale hand. A wave of force slams Varek into the stone wall. The fiend lunges forward to strike. Varek rolls clear as the iron cleaver shatters the floor.

Green fire sparks along the halberd blade. The heavy gate behind them swings fully open. Something far larger moves in the dark.

story_context:
Stone shatters. A behemoth of warped bone and jagged iron surges from the pit. Smoke pours from its split breastplate. Horns curl around a visage carved from night.

The beast wields a notched executioner cleaver. Runes of malice burn along the thick blade. Spiked chains bind its wrists to shattered stone. Its height towers over Varek.

Varek does not flinch. He drops the dead king's crown into the dust. He grips his greatsword with both gauntlets. The fiend roars and shakes the archway.

Iron meets hellfire in the dark. The first strike echoes across the dead soil. War has reached the gate. Deep within the archway, a second shadow stirs.

story_context:
The ash fell thick over the Iron Wastes. Varek did not slow his pace. His plate armor bore the dust of three fallen kingdoms. He pulled his greatsword from the frozen dirt.

Cold runes cut deep into the notched steel. Heavy pauldrons guard a neck scarred by ancient iron. A tattered war cloak drags through the red soil. He carries the crown of a dead king in his left gauntlet.

Shadows twist around the obsidian archway ahead. Something heavy wakes beneath the stone floor. The ground cracks beneath his boots. Varek shifts his grip and sets his stance.

A clawed hand breaks through the flagstones. Red eyes ignite in the black depth. Varek raises his blade. Tomorrow, the horde rises.
